experience.body: Worked on a Puja campaign, supported the launch of FL SHIFT, and contributed to creative direction, visual storytelling, and fashion campaign execution.
Earned the Joint Secretary role after three years of involvement across DRMC’s clubs, joining a competitive panel of student leaders.
highlights: Co-hosted the 17th DRMC National Science & Codeavour International Carnival 2026: over 50,000 visitors across three days on the 52-acre campus, with 10,000+ participants competing in ten sectors.
Worked with the leadership panel to secure major sponsors and institutional partners.
Served as sole host for seven seminars and workshops, including co-organizing and hosting DRMC’s inaugural TEDx Talk.

experience.body: Selected from 40+ candidates to oversee 500+ college students at Dhaka Residential Model College, alongside its broader school campus.
highlights: Commanded weekly assemblies as Parade Commander, maintained college discipline, and served as the primary bridge between students and faculty.
Coordinated with the Magazine, Prayer, Cultural, Games, and Elder prefects throughout the academic year.

experience.body: Founded a social organization and led eight community projects, including wall art, awareness campaigns, and food drives. Coordinated people and operations from the ground up.
Produced visual content on a project basis over 2+ years for 10 Minute School, bKash, Pathao, and ARKA Fashion Week. Delivered documentary films and short-form reels for digital marketing campaigns.
Contributed to six major DRMC national and international events across operations, marketing, content creation, production, and event management.
